value.rationale: The result answers a concrete inner-sweep allocation question in quantized stationary iterative refinement. It shows that extra work can freeze correction entirely for even sweep counts despite exact residual refreshing, proves no faster worst-case outer-cycle convergence for all odd counts up to a sharp threshold, and gives a rigorous instability frontier on natural SPD graph families. The obstruction is an operator-level graph spectral phenomenon, not merely a relabeled arithmetic identity.
